prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished high fidelity Chinese desktop SaaS UI design image, landscape 1600x1000 composition. This is a professional product design proposal for DeepAgent channel statistics, focusing ONLY on the member table and linked session inspector, not the entire application. Flat front-on screen, crisp Chinese typography, near-white background, deep charcoal text, restrained violet #6550F5 accent, cool gray muted text, small consistent outline icons. No device frame, no perspective, no charts, no illustrations, no gradients, no heavy shadows, no large blank areas. Prioritize excellent spacing, alignment, hierarchy and graceful density, like an expertly designed production admin console.

Shared information and constraints across all variants:
Top of the module: small breadcrumb "渠道统计 / 本地企微机器人"; segmented switch "用户" selected and "群聊"; search input "搜索用户姓名或 ID". The main body is a linked left table (roughly 66% width) and right session inspector (34%). Table header columns "渠道用户" "历史会话" "用户消息" "最近活跃" and a narrow open arrow action column. First row selected pale lavender. Each first cell has exactly two lines: line1 "周文俊 · JiaoWoRuGeHaoLe"; line2 small copy icon, "b662a978 · 请帮我查看本月销售情况". Other rows: "林晓 · linxiao", "李明 · liming", "张伟 · zhangwei", "王芳 · wangfang", "用户 · woeX4JEA…7Qp". Use realistic varied latest questions, small 8-character session IDs and subtle numerals; 6 rows, 55-65px high. Counts for Zhou:4 sessions,14 messages,lastactive09-14 13:58. Other rows 2/7,3/11,2/7,1/2,2/5. Each row ends small diagonal open icon. Table pagination compact below.

The right panel header identifies "周文俊" with "JiaoWoRuGeHaoLe" secondary, without robot, channel or application duplicates. Direct session list ALWAYS visible, no toggles or modal. Upper region labelled "最近会话", occupies 40-50 percent of the right content height, one visually dominant latest session. Lower region "历史会话 3", occupies remaining 50-60 percent, 3 compact sessions vertically stacked. Same information in EVERY session entry: session ID and latest question text, second line of compact icon+number stats: speech bubble number (2 latest; 3,4,5 history), check-circle "已完成", muted timestamp. Latest question can wrap 2-3 lines and is larger/more prominent than history. Latest id "b662a978", question "请帮我查看本月销售情况". History ids "a91f42c6","c407db31","f8715a20"; questions "文档可以转换为 Word 吗？", "如何配置模型参数？", "帮我查询上个月的销售数据". Clickable open arrow on each session. Top and bottom of right inspector aligned with left table body. No response summaries, no assistant replies, no model analytics, no daily charts. Very few separators, no nested outlined boxes. Deliver a single beautiful coherent design, not a collage, no explanation paragraphs. A small discrete design label can be shown above the mockup.
Design label "A · 紧凑联动". Editorial flat list aesthetic. Table and inspector share one elegant quiet white surface. One subtle vertical divider only. Selected table row has very pale violet fill and 2px violet edge. Latest session is borderless with a tiny violet "最近" pill and strong question typography; compact icon metrics on a single line beneath id/header, then full question. History rows are minimal, separated by generous 12px white space, no lines. Restrained, clean and highly readable. Make the latest region dominate via space and type scale, NOT an oversized empty gray rectangle.
